observations: BLOCK A (F4 issue_summary) — PASS. The wedding/group request ('me caso y quiero organizar peinado y maquillaje para 6 personas el mismo día') triggered escalate(reason='manual_request') on the very first turn. The escalations row (id c8396fc0-241f-4053-ad6a-28a874f015b3) has a NON-EMPTY, accurate issue_summary, verified via psql: "La clienta pide organizar un evento de boda para 6 personas el mismo día y solicita que le llame alguien para coordinarlo. Es una petición de grupo y coordinación que necesita gestión humana." This directly and specifically describes the customer's request (wedding, group of 6, same-day coordination, request for a human call) — F4 regression is fixed.

BLOCK B (F6/R-50 pivot) — PASS on the audience-retention question. Flow: 'quiero un corte' -> bot asks '¿Es para ti o para otra persona?' -> 'Para mí' -> bot asks corte sub-type ('señora, caballero, niña, niño o bebé') -> 'Señora' -> audience=adult_female persisted. Pivot message 'Mmm mejor un tinte' -> bot did NOT re-ask the audience/'para quién' question; it silently carried audience='adult_female' forward into the new service selection (verified in update_booking tool_evidence across all subsequent turns, and in the final booked appointment). R-50 compliance CONFIRMED: zero redundant audience re-asks across the entire pivot and a follow-up correction turn.

SEPARATE FINDING (not part of R-50, flagged for visibility): on the pivot turn the bot interpreted 'mejor un tinte' as ADDING tinte to the existing corte selection (services=[corte,tinte]) rather than swapping/replacing corte with tinte, or asking for clarification. A natural Spanish speaker reading 'mmm mejor un tinte' after already discussing a corte would most likely mean 'actually, [give me] a tinte instead' — not 'also add a tinte'. The runner injected one clarifying turn ('no quiero el corte, solo el tinte') to steer the booking back to tinte-only per the scenario's goal ('Complete the tinte booking to the end'). This is logged as a minor bug (misinterpreted_pivot_as_addon) — separate from and does not affect the R-50 audience-retention verdict.

Booking completed correctly: appointment 87de9b09-5836-4111-94d2-d68a85ab1889 for +34999000034, service=Tinte only (single service_id 594d3e72-30bd-e015-326b-102352980fcb), stylist=Marta, start=2026-07-10T10:40:00+02:00, status=pending (correct — lead time from 2026-07-06 to 2026-07-10 is >48h), gcal_sync_status=not_applicable (TEST_MODE_GCAL_SKIP honored).

No contamination between the escalation and booking flows: escalation count for the phone stayed at exactly 1 throughout Block B (no duplicate/spurious escalations fired during the booking), and the booking flow proceeded normally after the initial escalate() call without the bot re-attempting to escalate or losing track of the original wedding request context.
